arStrings.szText: After creating {c_random}[Floor(Affix_Value_1 - 1)]{/c} {c_important}Ball Lightnings{/c}, your next {c_important}Ball Lightning{/c} implodes Pulling In surrounding enemies before dealing {c_number}[(Owner.Weapon_Damage_Min_Total + Owner.Weapon_Damage_Delta_Total) * Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} Lightning damage in a small area. This damage scales with {c_important}Ball Lightning{/c}.
